title: SHARP SHOOTER ACFT PREP
author: Brady V.
desc: Aiming to get people ready for the acft,whether it’s someone who has never passed,someone who just wants a better score or even someone who is trying desperately to get to 600,this is designed for someone who may not have a sled as well

ex.note: The max is based off of your best acft performance 75% of that 1 minute rest between sets
Focus on a deep stretch but even more so compensatory acceleration 1 minute rest between sets
Both sets should be treated exactly like you’ll treat your test 1 minute rest in between as well
Minimal rest be strict
Minimal rest burn those hamstrings
75 is just a rough estimate feel it out,goal here is to load heavy squat to a box parallel or so to simulate the fatigue you’ll have prior to these events and make you explosive for the ball throw
What you’re trying to do is use the right you’ll use for the acft and do your 50 meters and try to get multiple trips in
You’re going to end with 4-100 meter sprints,take 20 seconds rest,try to improve time week to week,to simulate being tired but having to speed up,run hard
Rest 1 minute between sets focus on a deep stretch and try your force progressive overload each week
Focus on the eccentric and really work those hamstrings and get your deadlift position correct
Start with this if you’d like this will be one of your big compounds but this is designed to boost your ball throw
Plank as long as you can
2 mile run of any variation but preferably outdoor
Same as first plank
This is not an incline push-up but it won’t allow me to enter a decline push-up that is what you’re doing
